basic_info.description: Perched on the 14th floor of a distinguished Art Deco building, Residence #1402 offers an unparalleled vantage point high above the city in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, Russian Hill. This sophisticated condominium captures sweeping views of downtown, the Bay Bridge, and shimmering Bay waters. Sunlight pours into the expansive living room through broad, panoramic windows, illuminating beautifully refinished hardwood floors and turning the skyline into your daily art. The dining area flows seamlessly into a well-appointed kitchen, creating an ideal space for entertaining or relaxing at home. A versatile bonus room offers endless potentialwhether as a home office or additional storage. The generously sized bedroom is a peaceful retreat, comfortably fitting a king-sized bed and offering picture-perfect views of Coit Tower. A large walk-in closet provides ample storage, while the adjacent Art Deco-inspired bathroom features a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and elegant vintage charm. Residents of this iconic building enjoy an array of premium amenities including a 24-hour doorman, valet parking, elevator access, and convenient in-building laundry. Effortless living meets timeless elegance at one of San Francisco's premier addresses.
